Philadelphia County, Pennsylvania property tax involves the county assessment office and the tax claim bureau. This guide lists what we confirmed on official pages.

Who to contact in Philadelphia County

  • Department of Revenue handles collection and delinquent tax.
  • Office of Property Assessment handles assessment and appeals.

What we confirmed on official pages

  • Amount of Real Estate Tax owed is determined by the value assessed by the Office of Property Assessment (OPA).
  • Real Estate Tax due March 31; additions accrue at 1.5% per month from April 1 until January 1; on Jan 1 unpaid taxes get up to 15% addition, are registered delinquent, liens filed, and the City can begin sheriff sale process.

Assessment appeals

The statutory default appeal deadline is September 1, and a county may set a date no earlier than August 1 (53 Pa.C.S. 8844). See the Pennsylvania property tax guide.

Tax rate

We could not confirm a current county rate on an opened official page. Pennsylvania bills combine county, municipal and school district levies.
